quests.title: In Expert Company? (I)

dialogue.t: Please, adventurer, please go get us our Film Kamera back.
This shoot has been nothing but disasters...
*sigh* When will I get to go back to Qiaoying Village...
Great! The Film Kamera is intact, and the film hasn't been destroyed...
Thank the Archons. I thought we were gonna have to start shooting all over again.

dialogue.sit: Seems you aren't from Fontaine either.

dialogue.t: It's a long story...
Most people there are in the tea business but we... don't have any interest in tea...
So, we changed professions and started filming dokumentari films to help promote tea vendors in the village.
In truth, there are too many people in the tea business, and we just couldn't compete.
The skilled helpers we had at the store left one by one to work elsewhere, so if we just stuck to making tea, we'd be starving.
Can't you two... not make things sound so depressing!?
We've made plenty of Mora shooting these tea dokumentaris in the village.
But recently, some others in the village have also started to shoot their own promotional films.
Some of them are even performing an opera in them. They're making a real big show of it.
So that's why we're in Fontaine. We're trying to seek advice from master filmmakers!

dialogue.sit: So, you're here to learn about filmmaking in Fontaine?

dialogue.t: Yeah. We found this "lighting expert" called Geisert.
He's real good at using lighting to film... what was it again?
"Narratives."
Yeah! Applying lighting to his "narratives."
With Mr. Geisert's advice, we can definitely shoot the best films in all of Qiaoying Village!
Boss, last month you said we were going to shoot the best films in Liyue.
You have to adjust your expectations realistically when doing business... What do you know?
Anyway, thanks for your help, Traveler. Here, take this Mora.
Xingye, Yifeng, pack that up quick! We gotta finish shooting our sample and show it to Mr. Geisert.
Watch the lighting! The Kamera's gotta be angled toward the light source in this way. We gotta capture that... high-definition lighting!
You all read that book, right? The lighting's gotta have a sense of texture? You get what I'm saying?
Boss, we might've read Mr. Geisert's book...
But with what we got, we're not going to be able to capture that high-definition lighting tactility you want no matter how much we struggle...

quests.description: In the Court of Fontaine, you meet a group of people from Liyue…
